title: exp008固定预测与物理口径下的费用唯一目标对照
user_request: 其他都保持不变，就是不用去管优化充放电次数，而是全部服务于最小化总费用这个目标函数，模型构建等等的方法基本不变，与这个exp008形成一个对照实验；做完报告后推送远程
selection_policy: predeclared single controlled treatment; report every question including regressions; no tuning or selection by realized evaluation fees

fixed.forecast: exact accepted exp008 question-specific issued predictions, no retraining or changed calibration
fixed.raw_data: same five input CSV byte hashes as exp008
fixed.soc_state: each treatment carries its own realized state; never copy exp008 later-day states
fixed.terminal_value: unchanged economic continuation proxy for future purchases; zero on final evaluation day; excluded from actual bills
fixed.billing: same actual original purchases, one final adjustment charge, fivefold emergency cost; true tariff only for settlement
fixed.model_classes: same deterministic MILP, physical common-mode MIP plus fixed-mode L-BFGS refinement, or same rolling seven-scenario LP as the corresponding exp008 question
fixed.unknown_future: same legal issue times and historical labels; no current-day future observations used for planning

interpretation: Remove intensity-related optimization and Q2 explicit switching budget. Do not enlarge battery hardware/ramp constraints or change the hourly discretization of the Q4-2 model. This is a controlled bundle of stated objective-related changes, not a one-coefficient causal experiment.
failure_policy: retain feasible time-limited MIP incumbents with actual gaps; if no feasible incumbent or physical verification failure, stop and record the failure without silently increasing budgets or retuning; a numerical defect repair must be documented separately

reporting.year_status: same repeatedly used2025 development evaluation; not an untouched holdout
reporting.comparators: exp008 exactly plus prior historical experiments, exclude exp007

remote.name: origin
remote.push: new branch only; no force push or main merge
